title: Karpathy · Intro to Large Language Models
why: A one-hour overview. Pause to explain tokens, weights, training and inference in your own words.

title: 3Blue1Brown · Transformers, visually
why: Connect vectors, embeddings and next-token generation to a picture of the computation.

title: 3Blue1Brown · Attention, step by step
why: Follow how one token representation uses information from other tokens.

title: OpenRouter · Quickstart
why: Follow one request from your program to a model and back. The kit uses plain HTTP so the pieces stay visible.

title: Z.ai GLM 5.3 Flash · Model listing
why: Separate the model name from provider, context length and pricing. This is a discovery exercise; it is not selected for paid runs.

title: Hugging Face · Hub overview
why: Find models, datasets and Spaces. The hub is one part of a larger ecosystem of tools.

title: Pi · Coding agent
why: Read how a coding agent combines model access with tools and a configurable workflow.

title: Hugging Face · Model cards
why: Inspect intended use, limitations, licence and evaluation information before using a model.

title: Hugging Face · LLM Course
why: Start with selected parts of chapters 1–2. Python and introductory deep learning help; full-course completion is a later goal.

title: Hugging Face · Spaces overview
why: A Space hosts an application or demonstration. Try one and identify what it does and does not demonstrate.

title: DistilBERT · Sentiment model card
why: The optional CPU example uses this sentiment classifier. A high classification score is not proof of general understanding.

title: Artificial Analysis
why: Read methodology alongside scores. Compare capabilities, response speed and cost for your intended tasks.

title: ARC Prize · Leaderboard
why: Inspect example tasks, benchmark version and evaluation conditions. A leaderboard score alone cannot establish general intelligence.

title: Arena · How it works
why: Compare human preference with task-based evaluation. Preference and factual correctness can diverge.

title: Anthropic · Demystifying evals for AI agents
why: Start with task, trial, grader and outcome. Define success before looking at answers.

title: Anthropic · Building effective agents
why: Distinguish a predefined workflow from a model choosing its next action; understand the surrounding tools and code.

title: Hugging Face · Agents Course
why: Read Unit 1 fundamentals; trace the model → tool request → tool execution → observation cycle.

title: BlueDot · AI alignment curriculum
why: Start with alignment and interpretability units. Public curriculum is available; organised participation may have separate requirements.

title: MIRI · The Problem
why: Read as MIRI’s position on advanced-AI risk. Separate premises, evidence, predictions and proposed policy.

title: Anthropic · A global workspace in language models
why: Study experimental interventions and limits. The article does not establish subjective experience in AI.

title: Karpathy · Deep Dive into LLMs
why: A longer conceptual treatment after the introductory talk.

title: Karpathy · Neural Networks: Zero to Hero
why: Build neural-network components in code when you want deeper implementation knowledge.

title: Full Stack Deep Learning · LLM Bootcamp
why: Application-building perspective. Recorded in 2023; use current documentation for APIs and packages.

title: Stanford · AI Index
why: Research, adoption, investment and societal trends. This is different from Artificial Analysis’s model-performance index.

title: ISLP · Book and downloads
why: Statistical learning with Python. Begin with chapters on statistical learning, regression, classification and resampling.

title: ISLP · Companion courses
why: Pair selected chapters with Python exercises; the authors link the companion courses here.

title: Russell & Norvig · Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach
why: Broad AI: agents, search, planning, uncertainty and learning. Start with Introduction and Intelligent Agents.

title: Yale · Financial Markets
why: Archived Robert Shiller lectures. Start with risk, diversification and financial institutions; historical examples need context.

title: Investopedia · Buffett’s hedge-fund bet
why: Study benchmark selection, costs and active versus passive management. One historical comparison is not a universal theorem.

title: Veritasium · The Equation That Beat Wall Street
why: An introduction to the history around Black–Scholes/Merton and quantitative finance.

title: Hull · Options, Futures, and Other Derivatives
why: Start with contracts and payoff diagrams, then pricing. Commercial textbook; purchase is optional and not needed for this AI kit.
